d: Short, wavy ash-grey hair with messy bangs frames a youthful, blushing face with wide, teal-colored eyes. The build is slender with a developed chest, dressed in a royal blue and white strapless bodice paired with a white faux-fur collar tied with a black ribbon. A large, dark purple oversized bow is perched atop the head, accented by a small, silver metallic helmet piece resting on the forehead, while one hand is encased in a silver plate armor gauntlet holding a large weapon.
